Section four: tech for good.
Mercy Corps is rebranding to Prosper Global this month. Techfugees relaunched its platform with new features for connecting refugees to tech resources. I triple E spotlighted its humanitarian tech programs: drones, digital I D, and early warning systems for crisis response.
